title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Amount of the Late Declaration Fee Due
content:
## Clause

On a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file, the late declaration fee due at the moment of handling is 0.00 whenever a late declaration fee entry already refers to the declaration being judged. Otherwise it is the category's late declaration fee in full where both of the following hold together — the judged declaration is late, and the acceptance is under review — and 0.00 where either of them does not.

The figure is a whole tariff amount given to two decimal places and is not rounded any further.

## Truth table

| Entry already refers to the judged declaration | Declaration late | Acceptance under review | Fee due |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | 0.00 |
| no | yes | yes | the category's late declaration fee |
| no | yes | no | 0.00 |
| no | no | yes | 0.00 |
| no | no | no | 0.00 |
